_note: Fictional comments written for tests (not BMW data, not real customers). taxonomy_request = the label a human would give.

comments.text: In January the range drops so much that I have to stop twice on a 300 km trip.
Highway range is far below what the brochure promised.
To change the seat heating I need three taps in a submenu. That is dangerous while driving.
I can never find the setting for the ambient light; the menu structure is confusing.
After two hours on the motorway my lower back hurts; the seats need better support.
Please offer ventilated front seats, summers here are very hot.
The car often does not recognise the key and the doors stay locked.
The digital key on my phone stopped working after the last update.
The wipers leave a wide streak right in my line of sight.
Side mirrors are too small to see the lane next to me.
I would love a built-in fridge between the rear seats for long journeys.
Absolutely love how quiet and smooth this car is on the highway.
